description: CSRF protection and HttpOnly secure cookies must remain enabled.
Foreign key integrity and audit timestamps must be maintained on all entity updates.
The system must strictly prevent the last OWNER account from demoting themselves to USER or suspending their account. Any attempt must return 400 Bad Request with a clear safety error.
verificationMethod: Automated unit tests validating self-demotion and last-owner protection rejection

description: Secrets (SESSION_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, passwordHash, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, SMTP_PASSWORD, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET) must never be returned in API payloads, serialized to browser HTML, or logged into AdminAuditLog.
scope: API Responses, Client Serialization & Audit Logs
verificationMethod: Static AST audit, sanitized audit logger test, and API response schema validation
source: FAZ 1.5 Specification Milestone U & Audit Logger

description: Database migrations must be completely non-destructive: no DROP TABLE, no DROP COLUMN, safe nullable/default columns, and idempotent PostgreSQL DDL protected with IF NOT EXISTS and DO EXCEPTION blocks.
verificationMethod: Static SQL migration review, dry-run schema validation, and prisma client generation verification
